evidence.rationale: Sampled record references include working-format PMID/DOI/source URL anchors rather than only database navigation.

review_status.rationale: Sampled record headers explicitly state their workflow state.

curation_history.rationale: Sampled records show dated curation-event sections with attribution and action text.

source_link.rationale: Sampled record pages link their own YAML source file rather than just the repository root.

domain_view.rationale: Domain figures or maps rendered in the independently opened routes, with data-bearing visuals.

cross_mech_links.rationale: Sampled record content includes a direct link to a specific sibling record; navigation links were excluded.

corpus_stats.rationale: The generated landing figures were read from the browser and compared with the audited corpus counts.

category_browse.rationale: Landing links lead into distinct category subsets with continuation where needed.

suite_nav.rationale: Visible suite-directory links occur in the reviewed navigation or footer.

downloads.rationale: The linked index and individual record files do not constitute a linked bulk scientific record export.

schema_docs.rationale: Visible schema links reach raw LinkML YAML; consistent fleet arbitration requires partial when rendered schema documentation is not provided.

license.rationale: Reviewed landing, browser, records and maps distinguish CC BY data from BSD code.

build_provenance.rationale: The date refers to ChEBI/CARD upstream retrieval; the corpus digest is not a dated own-record release.

theme_toggle.rationale: Dark was selected and independently carried across the valid reviewed routes.

responsive.rationale: Every valid reviewed route was checked at fresh and resized 390px; none exceeded the viewport.

LinkML-validated YAML under data/antibiotics/. Schema, bulk JSON exports, curation history and the seeding pipeline all live in the repository.

One AntibioticRecord is one chemical structure — a compound with a defined connectivity (an InChIKey), not a drug class. "Macrolide antibiotic" is a structural class and appears as structural_class on the records it covers; erythromycin A is a record. AntibioticMech merges ChEBI's antimicrobial role hierarchy with CARD's Antibiotic Resistance Ontology (ARO) molecule list onto one identity per structure, and layers on the mechanism a compound list does not carry: molecular target, mode of action, and resistance route.
What the mechanism layer holds so far

ChEBI and ARO supply identity, structure and cross-references for every record. The mechanism fields below are what curation adds on top, one record at a time — most are still empty, which is the honest state of an incrementally curated corpus.

SEEDED and REVIEWED describe recorded curation workflow states. Curation may be agent-assisted; these counts do not establish human review. Consult each record’s curation history for the actor and method.
